romanized_text:
arav aur riy ek hi skul men padhate the aur pakke dost the. ek din skul men vijnana mele ki ghoshan hui. arav bahut utsahit hokar riy ke pas daudaa aur bol, riya, hamen is bar kuch jabaradasta banan hai. agar ham jit gae to pure skul men hamar nam hog. riy ne hansate hue kaha, bilkula, chal aj se hi shuru karate hain.

donon ne milakar ek chot robot banane k phaisal kiya. lekin kuch hi dinon men mushkilen ane lagin. ek sham robot k sarkit bara-bara jal jata tha. arav jhunjhal kara bol, yaha kam hi nahin kara rah. mainne itani mehanat ki aur sab bekar j rah hai. riy ne use shant karate hue kaha, itana pareshan mat ho, ham phir se koshish karenge.

usi rat arav apani dadi ke pas gaya aur sari bat batai. dadi ghar ki sabase bujaurg sadasy thin. arav ne kaha, dadi, mujhe lagat hai main har jaung. dadi ne pyar se usak sir sahalay aur bolin, beta, dhairy rakho. mehanat kabhi bekar nahin jati. har asaphalat kuch sikhati hai. arav ko unaki bat se nai himmat mili.

agale din vijnana mele men adhyapak sharm sabhi pariyojanaon ki janch kara rahe the. ve apani sakhati ke lie jane jate the. unhonne arav se puch, tumane yaha robot kaise banay aur isak asali upayog kya hai? arav ne shanti se har saval k uttar diya. adhyapak sharm ne sir hilakar kaha, tumhari mehanat sapha dikhai deti hai.

parinam ki ghoshan hui aur arav tath riy ki tim pratham ai. riy khushi se chillai, hama jit gae! mujhe yakin hi nahin ho rah. arav ne hansate hue kaha, mainne kaha tha n, ham kamal kara denge. us sham donon doston ne apani jit k jashn manay aur dadi ko dhanyavad kaha jinaki baton ne unhen kabhi har nahin manane di.

key_events: The school announces a science fair.
Arav, excited, runs to Riy and proposes they create something spectacular to win and gain fame.
Riy laughs and agrees, saying they will start right away.
event_chain.scene_goal: Establish the close friendship and set up their joint ambition to compete in the science fair.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the opening of the story, Arav now rallies Riy to begin their science fair project.

key_events: Arav and Riy decide to build a small robot together.
Technical difficulties arise when the robot's circuit catches fire one evening.
Arav expresses frustration about the failed effort.
Riy comforts Arav, urging him not to worry and promising another attempt.
event_chain.scene_goal: Introduce a setback that tests the protagonists' resolve and reinforces their determination to succeed.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the establishment of their close friendship and joint ambition to compete in the science fair, Arav and Riy now face a technical setback while building their robot.

key_events: Arav goes to his grandmother's house at night and confides everything to her.
The grandmother, the eldest family member, gently comforts Arav and advises him to be patient and keep working hard.
Arav gains new courage from his grandmother's words.
event_chain.scene_goal: Arav receives emotional support and renewed determination to overcome his setback.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following the setback that tested the protagonists' resolve, Arav now seeks counsel from his grandmother.

key_events: Teacher Sharm is checking all projects at the upcoming science fair.
Sharm goes to meet his friend Arav.
Sharm asks Arav how he built the robot and what its real use is.
Arav calmly answers every question.
Sharm nods and says Arav's hard work is clearly visible.
event_chain.scene_goal: Sharm evaluates Arav's robot, confirming its value and showcasing Arav's competence after his renewed determination.
event_chain.location: Science fair venue / meeting place where Sharm visits Arav
event_chain.narrative_link: Following Arav receiving emotional support and renewed determination, Arav now demonstrates his robot to Teacher Sharm who evaluates his work.

key_events: The competition results are announced and Arav and Riy learn they have won.
Riy exclaims with joy, expressing disbelief at the victory.
Arav smiles and recalls having predicted their success.
Both friends celebrate their win that evening and thank their grandmother for her encouragement.
event_chain.scene_goal: To depict the protagonists' triumph and reinforce their bond while acknowledging the supportive role of their grandmother.
event_chain.narrative_link: Following Sharm's evaluation of Arav's robot, Arav now celebrates the competition win with Riy.
